mapper.select: SELECT OM.ORDERNUMBER, OM.BUILD, OM.SPEC, OM.CUSTOMER_ADAP AS sNoteNO, GENERAL.COUNTRY_OF_OPERATION AS market, MASTER.LOAD_INDEX AS loadIndex, HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE.ACT, MODIFICATION.VARIABLE, MODIFICATION.NEWVAL FROM HDOC_REC_DATA_OM OM INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_VDA_GENERAL GENERAL ON OM.SERIE = GENERAL.SERIE AND OM.CHNR = GENERAL.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_REC_DATA_KOLA_TIRE_MASTER MASTER ON GENERAL.BRAND_ID = MASTER.BRAND INNER JOIN HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE ON OM.SERIE = HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE.SERIE AND OM.CHNR = HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE.CHNR INNER JOIN HDOC_ADCA_MODIFICATION MODIFICATION ON OM.SERIE = MODIFICATION.SERIE AND OM.CHNR = MODIFICATION.CHNO WHERE OM.SERIE = #{chassisSeries} AND OM.CHNR = #{chassisNo} AND OM.TRANS_TS = #{documentType}
